# SPDX projection 2 compatibility fixture

`conditional.spdx.json` was generated by original main
`4aaf727809034d7a1c7ba47e9f389c2ab1e671d2`, before comment neutralization.
It carries a fixed native timestamp and an ordinary multiline condition with a
tab and a bidi control. It is intentionally frozen: recovery must use the
declared projection's rendering, while re-export produces neutralized projection
3 comments. Do not regenerate it with the current generator to repair a test.
